children: CareView Communications, Inc. (“CareView” or the “Company”) (OTCQB: CRVW), a leader in virtual patient observation and AI-powered safety solutions, in partnership with Decisive Point Consulting Group, today announced a new business agreement with the North Las Vegas VA Medical Center, part of the VA Southern Nevada Healthcare System.

The agreement includes portable and fixed CareView devices, along with mobile controllers, providing the medical center with expanded capabilities for virtual patient monitoring. The deployment represents a conversion from the facility’s existing system to CareView technology.

The North Las Vegas VA Medical Center is a major inpatient and high-complexity medical facility serving veterans throughout Southern Nevada. The facility provides comprehensive healthcare services to Veterans and is part of the Department of Veterans Affairs healthcare system.

CareView’s Patient Safety System enables clinical teams to remotely observe patients while maintaining real-time audio and video communication. The technology is designed to support patient safety workflows and provide healthcare professionals with additional tools to identify potential safety concerns and respond when intervention is needed.

“We are proud to expand our partnership both with Decisive Point Consulting Group and with the Department of Veterans Affairs and support the North Las Vegas VA Medical Center,” said Sandra McRee, Chief Operating Officer of CareView. “This deployment demonstrates the versatility of the CareView platform and our ability to support healthcare organizations transitioning from other virtual monitoring technologies. We look forward to helping the North Las Vegas team advance its patient safety and virtual observation capabilities.”

The deployment adds to CareView’s growing portfolio of VA healthcare customers and reinforces the Company’s focus on providing scalable virtual monitoring solutions across a range of clinical environments.

For more than a decade, CareView has empowered over 200 hospitals nationwide with its virtual nursing and virtual sitter solutions. The Company’s patient safety platform, supported by AI-enabled predictive tools, significantly reduces falls and alleviates staffing pressure – helping hospitals deliver more safe and efficient care. More information about the Company and its products and services are available at the Company’s website at https://www.care-view.com and https://www.linkedin.com/company/careview-communications/.
